title: Functoriality of sheaf cohomology
statement: For a scheme $X$, sheaf cohomology $H^i(X,-)$ is the $i$-th right derived functor of global sections on the abelian category of $\mathcal O_X$-modules described in [def-sc-ext-sheaf]. Hence every morphism $u:\mathcal G'\to\mathcal G$ induces $H^i(u):H^i(X,\mathcal G')\to H^i(X,\mathcal G)$ and $H^i(\varphi\circ u)=H^i(\varphi)\circ H^i(u)$ for composable module morphisms.
